details: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East have intensified due to the ongoing US naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, aimed at pressuring Iran. This has led to a significant spike in oil prices, with Brent crude reaching over $126 per barrel, its highest level in four years. Negotiations between the US and Iran remain stalled, and President Trump has indicated the blockade could last for months. The disruption to a crucial global oil transit route raises inflation risks and weighs on global equities.
title: US-Iran Tensions Escalate, Oil Prices Surge

details: The US Federal Reserve has maintained its benchmark interest rate at a target range of 3.5% to 3.75%. This decision reflects a cautious approach by policymakers as they evaluate inflation risks, which are compounded by rising energy prices and ongoing geopolitical instability, particularly in the Middle East. The market is closely watching for further indications on the future path of monetary policy, with potential changes in Fed leadership also contributing to uncertainty.
title: Federal Reserve Holds Rates Amid Geopolitical Instability

details: Despite heightened geopolitical tensions and surging oil prices, Bitcoin has demonstrated surprising stability, trading in a narrow range around $77,000. Institutional demand for Bitcoin remains strong, with Spot Bitcoin ETFs surpassing $102 billion in assets under management and recording significant net inflows in April. However, some analysts caution that the recent surge might be built on "shaky ground," and many altcoins have experienced declines, highlighting Bitcoin's increasing market dominance.
title: Bitcoin Shows Resilience Amidst Market Volatility and Institutional Inflows

details: The US "GENIUS Act" is set to reinforce the dollar's global reserve currency status by establishing a comprehensive federal regulatory framework for stablecoins, thereby creating structural demand for US dollar treasuries. Concurrently, Ripple is expanding its operations in the UAE, with its dollar-backed stablecoin RLUSD gaining approval for use in the Dubai International Financial Centre. In Asia, MoonPay Korea has partnered with Woori Bank to support the global distribution and cross-border settlement infrastructure for a new won-backed stablecoin market. The UK is also finalizing its own cryptoasset regime, bringing stablecoin issuance and safeguarding under regulation.
title: Global Stablecoin Adoption and Regulation Progress
